newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge up in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge up in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged up in early Monday morning trade, but participants remained reluctant to move actively due to uncertainty as to Japan's political picture after October 20 general elections, brokers said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average firmed 47.71 points or 0.23 percent to 21,015.87 in the first 10 minutes of trading. Its December futures were up 10 points at 21,050.
"With the elections upcoming, participants are tending to take a wait-and-seen stance," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
